title: NexTPA
description: Modern, lightweight TPA plugin with safety checks and clickable requests.
body:
NexTPA is a modern, lightweight teleport request plugin for Paper 1.21.1+ designed for fast servers and clean gameplay. It provides /tpa and /tpahere requests with clickable accept/deny buttons, configurable cooldowns to prevent spam, and a smooth actionbar countdown before teleporting.



It also includes optional safety checks to warn (or cancel) dangerous teleports (lava nearby, void risk, high fall, hostile mobs), plus player controls like /tpatoggle (disable receiving requests) and /tpablock (block specific players). Everything is fully configurable via config.yml and messages.yml with support for & colors and &#RRGGBB hex colors.



Features:



/tpa, /tpahere, /tpaccept, /tpdeny, /tpacancel
/tpatoggle to enable/disable receiving requests
/tpablock to block/unblock specific players
Cooldown + limits (max outgoing requests, max incoming queue)
Actionbar countdown before teleport
Optional safety checks (warn/cancel)
Clickable chat buttons for accept/deny/cancel
Tab completion
Configurable messages with hex colors
Optimized for large servers
Permissions:



nextpa.tpa
nextpa.tpahere
nextpa.accept
nextpa.deny
nextpa.admin (reload)
Commands:



/tpa
/tpa reload
/tpahere
/tpaccept
/tpdeny
/tpacancel [player]
/tpatoggle
/tpablock
